newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania protests over police action in Macedonia.
newsitem.headline: Albania protests over police action in Macedonia.

text.p: Albania summoned the Macedonian ambassador on Thursday to protest over police treatment of ethnic Albanians in Macedonia this week.

Two ethnic Albanians were shot dead, about 53 seriously injured and around 400 detained in a mass brawl with police on Wednesday in Gostivar, western Macedonia, according to state-run Macedonian radio.
Rioting erupted when police removed the Albanian national flag from outside the town hall in Gostivar under a new law which limits the flying of flags to special occasions.

Albanian Foreign Minister Arian Starova called in Macedonian ambassador Nikolla Todorcevski to express "profound indignation" about these acts which caused "extraordinary international tension", a statement said.
Tension between ethnic Albanians and Macedonians has been running high for years.
Ethnic Albanians are demanding political equality and their own university in Macedonia, where they claim to represent around 40 percent of the population.
The government says census figures show the figure is around 22 percent and Albanian demands for stronger identity are fiercely opposed by Macedonian nationalists.
